name: tmenu [with simple default menu]
run: mkdir -p ~/.local/bin ~/.local/share/man/man1 ~/.tmenu && cp -p src/sh/tmenu.sh ~/.local/bin/tmenu && cp -p src/sh/tmenu.1 ~/.local/share/man/man1/tmenu.1 && printf 'simple\n' > ~/.local/bin/.tmenu-install-status

name: tmenu [with default menu from current aliases]
run: mkdir -p ~/.local/bin ~/.local/share/man/man1 ~/.tmenu && cp -p src/sh/tmenu.sh ~/.local/bin/tmenu && cp -p src/sh/tmenu.1 ~/.local/share/man/man1/tmenu.1 && printf 'aliases\n' > ~/.local/bin/.tmenu-install-status
